entry.name: Piplup-H4
entry.flavor: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.
entry.flavorEs: Es muy orgulloso, por lo que odia aceptar comida de la gente. Su grueso plumón lo protege del frío.

abilities.textEn: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's offensive stat is 1.5x with Water attacks.
abilities.textEs: Potencia sus movimientos de tipo Agua cuando le quedan pocos PS.
abilities.detail: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Water-type attack.
abilities.detailEs: Cuando a este Pokémon le queda 1/3 o menos de sus PS, sus movimientos de tipo Agua infligen 1.5× de daño normal.
abilities.detailZh: 当该宝可梦剩余HP为1/3或以下时，其水属性招式造成1.5×的常规伤害。
abilities.detailPt: Quando este Pokémon tem 1/3 ou menos do seu HP restante, seus movimentos do tipo Água infligem 1.5× o dano normal.

abilities.textEn: This Pokemon's Sp. Atk is raised by 2 for each of its stats that is lowered by a foe.
abilities.textEs: Aumenta mucho su Ataque Especial cuando el rival le baja cualquiera de sus características.
abilities.detail: This Pokemon's Special Attack is raised by 2 stages for each of its stat stages that is lowered by an opposing Pokemon.
abilities.detailEs: Sube el Ataque Especial dos niveles cuando cualquiera de sus estadísticas es reducida.
abilities.detailZh: 任何能力被降低时，特攻提高2级。
abilities.detailPt: Aumenta o Ataque Especial em dois estágios ao ter qualquer atributo reduzido.
